description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Changeling Titan trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.
